concurrency: Read-only and re-entrant; concurrent readers are safe and observe the same bytes; no writes occur.
dependencies: accepted xverse_xdl.experiment_plan public API/digest semantics (read-only, unchanged)
accepted C++ X-COM observation contract 1.0.0 (read-only, unchanged)
deployment: Offline, in-process Python library and console entry point inside the admitted ARGUS2 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, provider handle, live tap, registry or oracle is created, started, probed or contacted.
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/argus-lite/requirements.md ARGUS2-SR-010, realized by ARGUS2-ARCH-10/ARGUS2-ARCH-07 in docs/engineering/argus-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen in docs/engineering/argus-lite/detailed-design.md.
responsibilities: Provide a bounded read-only reader that verifies manifest and artifact hashes and returns records, diagnostics and declared metric-input links through JSON/JSONL export.
Return a deterministic selection order (ingestion ordinal) so repeated reads of unchanged inputs yield equal content.
Report a corrupt artifact, hash mismatch or exceeded reader bound with a stable structured diagnostic and a bounded partial result rather than silent truncation or invented data.
Replay is evidence reconstruction only: never execute components, faults, lifecycle actions or an evaluation oracle, and never compute a metric value or emit control/actuation output.
state_ownership: Owns no writable state; reads and verifies existing evidence and holds only a bounded in-memory export buffer.
title: ARGUS2-SR-010-CMP allocation - Bounded read-only replay/export and metric-input links
